propositions: Undecomposed and dod_uncertifiable axes currently use ordinal labels (low/medium/high) that LLMs apply unreliably for deterministic gate behavior, and must be converted to closed semantic kind sets
The undecomposed axis should map to six kinds: none, bundles_separable_slices (advisory, 0.55), missing_required_child (floor), and no_executable_breakdown (floor)
The dod_uncertifiable axis should map to six kinds: none, underspecified_certification (advisory, 0.55), uncertifiable_outcome (floor), and certification_cannot_prove (floor)
The inert G5 hedge (veto_undecomposed_g5, fired zero times) must be removed from both verifier prompts and all descriptions
IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION must be bumped from plan-v4 to plan-v5, and the sidecar must record per-finding priority-minus-block_threshold margin telemetry
A zero-LLM re-score validating all 22,667 recorded findings shows zero unjustified lost blocks under the new kind-set mapping
